verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a physical graphics card that the buyer already owns and installs, so asking whether its core product can be self-hosted is a category error. That question fits SaaS or software deployment models, not consumer GPU hardware. The evidence on running vLLM, llama.cpp and the open-source ROCm stack locally is about self-hosting AI workloads on the card, not self-hosting the product itself, so it does not make this axis apply.
